html: Hi folks.  I wanted to give you a quick update on the publication status, not just of Wormhole, but of the entire Rho Agenda trilogy.  Through my literary agency, Janklow & Nesbit, I’ve just agreed to a contract with a major publishing house.  Over the coming weeks they will be re-editing all three novels and releasing them under their own imprint … more on that later.  What that means is that I’m no longer an indie author and, while I lose the day to day control of what gets released and when, my novels will have much broader distribution and will benefit from the publisher’s powerful marketing arm.  Since the final i dotting and t crossing won’t be complete for a couple more weeks, I can’t provide more details right now, but I’ll remedy that once the contract is finalized.
